news.title: World Cup newcomers join New Zealand at landmark U-15 tournament
news.lede: The inaugural FIFA U-15 Boys’ World Cup will bring together 189 national teams in Azerbaijan, including 78 countries making their first FIFA World Cup appearance. New Zealand are among 11 Oceania nations taking part in the six-day tournament, which gets underway in Baku on Saturday (NZT). The competition, officially named the FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival, has been designed to give young footballers international experience while supporting their development. FIFA say many participants will be travelling overseas for the first time, with the event combining football, education and cultural activities.

news.title: Spain defeat CommBank Junior Matildas 3-1 in second group stage game
news.lede: The CommBank Junior Matildas have been defeated 3-1 by Spain in their second group stage game at the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup™. Frida Karaberis scored in the second half in a fighting effort against one of the favourites for the tournament. Head Coach Mike Cooper made two changes to the side that picked up a historic first point on this stage against Chile. Charlotte Bradshaw was rewarded for her goal with a start, with Keira Sarris starting from the bench.
